text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day.
I came along with Mihono Bourbon
to help out at the Yukoma Onsen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Order complete.
I have delivered your luggage to your room.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! As expected of an Umamusume!
Handling that massive amount of work is pure competence~~!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, that was a huge help♪
Hey, everyone! Thanks to this big sister,
we got to take it easy~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
“Smile” detected.
—I am glad to have been of service.

text_block_list.name: Customer's Companion
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, don't get so carried away!
Your knee just healed up, didn't it?
Tell me if you need a break, okay?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Totally fine~♪ You're worrying way too much!
This is the fun trip we've been planning for ages, right?♪
We gotta make the most of it☆

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
And so! Could you take a picture for us?
We're gonna jump on three, so snap it then☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I took the camera, timed the shot, and clicked the shutter. The result was a commemorative photo filled to the brim with bursting smiles.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The expressions, the poses, the situation.
Any way you look at it, it's a "fun commemorative photo."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master. The proprietress informed me
that peak hours have passed.
Current status: "Relieved for now."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take a break too.
Alright, let's take a break too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes—
! ...Master, that person is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following where she pointed...
I saw the previous customer sitting there, looking dazed.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text: ...Is my knee... really just... done for?
choice_data_list: (Earlier, she didn't seem like that at all...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me,
why do you act so cheerful like that?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah, earlier...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you look like you're suffering.
It is the exact opposite of the emotion known as 'cheerful.'

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... No.
It's fine. This is enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why...?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, there they are! You're all so slooow!
I've been waiting forever☆

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey! If you're free, could you help me out with a photoshoot again?
Please?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Mihono Bourbon helped them out while
I snapped the photos. And so, one by one,
we added to our collection of memories.

text_block_list.name: Customer's Companion
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the greenery on the mountain in the back is gorgeous too!
Looks great!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
We did great too! Way to go♪
Let's head over there next~!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Does everyone have their manju~?
Alright, take a little bite and strike a pose!
Ready, set...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for your hard work.
choice_data_list: I'll return the camera to you.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you.
Even with that puzzled look on your face,
you stayed by my side the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...May I ask why?
I... could not understand.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Customer
text_block_list.text:
...You'd want to end on a good memory, right?
At least for the last moment before quitting the club...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master. In front of her companions,
she maintained a smile the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...However, beneath those visible emotions,
there was another feeling entirely."
choice_data_list: She was such a strong-willed person, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Behind a smile, it is not always...
'joy,' is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the summer sun, she stood still.
Simply gazing as if peering beyond the heat haze.
